test_title: PYST 11: SSC CGL 2023 - Reasoning (Held On: 18 Jul 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option that represents the letters that, when placed from left to right in the following blanks, will complete the letter-series.

M N B _ C M _ _ W C M N B _ _ M _ _ Y C

options.text: V N B X C N B
V N B Y D N B
W Y Y Y C N B
W N B Y D N B

solution: **Given:** M N B _ C M _ _ W C M N B _ _ M _ _ Y C Checking all the given options: **1. V N B X C N B** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b8140e65c4b09b4480ad1b4314eef20cd33b65550ad6f4bfbcf6c348d565af40.png]
